sentences.english: Today Ana works at the clinic.

sentences.text: Në klinikë ka një djalë me nënën.
sentences.english: At the clinic there is a boy with his mother.

sentences.text: — Jam nëna. Ai nuk pi ujë.
sentences.english: "I am the mother. He does not drink water."

sentences.text: — A do ujë? A do çaj?
sentences.english: "Do you want water? Do you want tea?"

sentences.text: Në klinikë ka edhe një vajzë.
sentences.english: At the clinic there is also a girl.

sentences.text: Ajo është e lodhur, por është mirë.
sentences.english: She is tired, but she is well.

sentences.text: Ana nuk është e lodhur tani.
